title: Diff sets min_instances = 0 but unit test asserts prod min_instances == 1 — full test suite fails
evidence:
tests/unit/test_concurrency.py:
    def test_min_instances(self) -> None:
        # min_instances = 1 keeps one warm instance so Gleam's
        # `session_create` POST never lands on a cold start. Bumped 0→1 in
        # commit 9816019 after staging cold-start failures on 2026-05-04.
        prod_tfvars = PRODUCTION_TFVARS.read_text()
        assert _extract_literal_int(prod_tfvars, "min_instances") == 1

deployment/terraform/vars/production.tfvars:21:
min_instances = 0

Verified by running `uv run pytest tests/unit/test_concurrency.py -q`:
E       assert 0 == 1
1 failed, 7 passed
detail: The changed line violates an existing encoded invariant. The repo's test gate (`uv run pytest`) now fails on every run until the test or value is reconciled. Commit 1ab67ba touched only the tfvars file.
recommended_fix: Update test_min_instances to expect 0 and rewrite its comment (mirror the tfvars rationale + tripwire), or revert min_instances to 1. Include the test change in this diff.

title: First-request cold-start path unguarded: observed 27.7s boot vs ~42s Gleam retry runway, and history shows the budget was once burned
evidence:
deployment/terraform/vars/production.tfvars:21:
min_instances = 0

deployment/terraform/variables.tf (min_instances description):
    `session_create:connection_failure` on 2026-05-04 (19:07, 22:57, 23:49,
    01:52, 07:07) when min=0 — Gleam's HTTP client timed out before the new
    instance finished booting and burned its retry budget. Per-env override
    accepts that tradeoff explicitly.

tests/load_test/baselines/2026-04-18-phase2-vertex-sessions/README.md:26:
- Session-create latency: 27.7s (one-time cold start — we had just deployed a fresh revision)
detail: Request arriving at zero instances waits out full container boot. Boot observed at 27.7s leaves ~14s margin under the ~42s retry runway; 2026-05-04 evidence shows this exact budget was exhausted before. Diff carries only a comment — no startup_cpu_boost, alert, or other guard.
recommended_fix: Add `startup_cpu_boost = true` to service.tf template to shrink boot time, or add a monitoring alert on session_create connection_failure so the 2026-05-04 recurrence is caught immediately.

title: Merge-to-prod path never applies this change: deploy-to-prod.yml paths filter excludes deployment/terraform/** and the workflow runs no terraform step
evidence:
.github/workflows/deploy-to-prod.yml:
    paths:
      - "tenant_scorer/**"
      - "tests/**"
      - "pyproject.toml"
      - "uv.lock"
      - "Makefile"
      - "Dockerfile"
      - "main.py"
      - ".github/workflows/**"

The workflow's only deploy step is:
          gcloud run deploy ${{ env.SERVICE_NAME }} \
            --source . \
            --region ${{ vars.REGION }} \
detail: A merge containing only this tfvars edit matches no path filter, and even on trigger the workflow runs gcloud deploy only. Scale-to-zero takes effect solely via a manual terraform apply; nothing in the diff or CI performs it.
recommended_fix: State in the PR body that merging triggers no workflow and the change lands only after a manual `terraform apply` against prod; optionally add deployment/terraform/** to the paths filter.
